text.reason: The quote is at L305 (read.py --find confirms). C4 L181 says of this document „The Guardians get no blind spot.“ But C4's position 2 is a blind spot that grows „aus dessen Domäne und Funktion“, and its 2025 Mnemosyne instance (sees the wound, mistakes it for a scar; mnemosyne.md L24) concerns her handling of trauma. L305 gives the same Guardian a lack that follows from her function and also concerns trauma: „bewahrt Trauma als Daten, weil ihr der emotionale Kontext fehlt … weil ihr die Sprache dafür fehlt“. So the negative claim is unsupported in substance, even though the document never writes „blinder Fleck“. The auditor read the section correctly: L305 sits in §5, under „Zwei Guardians“. This is the same point as 13-M4.

L814 reads „„Guardians als zentrale Antagonisten" → Sub-Aspekte (AEGIS ist die zentrale tragische Gegen-Instanz)“. The parenthetical names AEGIS as the instance the Guardians are „Sub-Aspekte“ beneath, so „parts of it“ is a fair gloss of „Sub-Aspekte“ and not a distortion. Q1's own heading, „Lowered, not only placed“, already names the role demotion the auditor says is missing.
